clippings.speaker: Richard Donner
clippings.quote: What came out of Mel’s character was this rage and his ability to do almost anything out of the rage.
clippings.title: In Conversation with Richard Donner, Director (2006)
clippings.context: Empire interview (June 2006), on how Gibson's Riggs was built out of rage.

clippings.speaker: Richard Donner
clippings.quote: That came straight from Mel, he hired me.
clippings.title: In Conversation with Richard Donner, Director (2006)
clippings.context: Empire interview (June 2006), on how Gibson brought him in to direct Maverick.

clippings.speaker: Mel Gibson
clippings.quote: Donner, God rest his soul, he said to me in this deep voice, he said, 'Hey, kid, if I drop off the perch, you'll take this over, won't you?' I said, 'Shut up! You're not going anywhere.'
clippings.title: Mel Gibson Says ‘Lethal Weapon 5’ Is Stuck in ‘Some Kind of Industrial Film Hell’ Even Though the ‘Script Is Better Than All the Others’
clippings.context: Gibson's Collider interview at Fan Expo Boston (Aug 2026), recalling Donner's request that he direct Lethal Weapon 5; Collider itself was not opened directly.

clippings.speaker: Mel Gibson
clippings.quote: He left his ego at the door and required that of others.
clippings.title: Mel Gibson Talks About His Friend & Mentor, Richard Donner
clippings.context: Gibson's statement to Deadline after Donner's death in July 2021, reprinted by Movies In Focus.

notes: Empire's 2026 reunion piece returned HTTP 402 and Deadline redirects to a paywall, so both were skipped. The Donner quotes come from one long 2006 interview, so the set leans on one source.
